items.title: A Guide To Reiki Level 1 Attunement
items.author: Reiki Fish
items.excerpt: A Reiki Level 1 attunement is often described as one of the more significant moments in a practitioner's life — yet many people walk away feeling very little at all. This guide covers what actually happens in the ceremony, the philosophy behind it, the 21-day clearing period, and an honest look at what the research says.
items.imageAlt: Person receiving a Reiki Level 1 attunement, hands resting gently near the head during a calm training session

items.title: What Kids Really Feel When a Parent Alienates the Other Parent: An Evidence-Led Guide for Understanding and Responding
items.author: Reiki Fish
items.excerpt: \"Children's nervous systems encode threat patterns through repeated experiences, overheard conversations, and emotional climate shifts. This is not manipulation—it's adaptation. When a child learns that expressing attachment to Dad creates consequences, their threat system becomes active. Over time, what began as 'what I say to keep things calm' can become 'what I believe.'\"
items.imageAlt: Diagram showing reinforcement cycle of threat encoding and nervous system activation in parent alienation patterns\"

items.title: Child’s “Rights” When a Child Is Coerced: What It Means for a Parent (England & Scotland)
items.author: Reiki Fish
items.excerpt: Under pressure from an alienating or coercing parent? This evidence-led guide explains how the child’s views are assessed in Scotland & England, what “coerced” can mean in court, and what steps to take to protect your child’s welfare and your position (with practical evidence and safer contact options).
items.imageAlt: Evidence-led family court guidance showing how children’s views are assessed when pressure or coercion may be present in Scotland & England.

items.title: Fighting for Your Child: Do Scottish Family Courts Fail Fathers?
items.author: Reiki Fish
items.excerpt: This detailed article examines the systemic issues faced by fathers in Scottish family courts, highlighting historical biases, current patterns, and the urgent need for reform. It advocates for involving trained psychologists to ensure fair outcomes and emphasizes the importance of balancing parental rights for the wellbeing of children.
items.imageAlt: Father advocating for fair access to children in Scottish family courts

items.title: The Grey Method: Staying Regulated When Someone Wants a Reaction
items.author: Reiki Fish
items.excerpt: When someone wants an emotional reaction, remaining calm can feel almost impossible. The Grey Method, guided by Andy Fish’s Walking the Grey, offers a structured way to pause, regulate fear, protect your boundaries and respond without surrendering truth or identity.
items.imageAlt: The Grey Method showing a calm person remaining emotionally regulated while surrounded by conflict and provocation

items.title: What Is a Narcissist? The Evidence-Led Guide to Narcissism, Traits and NPD
items.author: Reiki Fish
items.excerpt: The word narcissist is everywhere. It is used for selfish partners, difficult exes, arrogant bosses, attention-seeking influencers, controlling parents and almo...
items.imageAlt: Narcissism and NPD illustrated through contrasting grandiose and vulnerable self-image

items.title: My Ex Won’t Let Me See My Children: What Can I Do as a Dad?
items.author: Reiki Fish
items.excerpt: Has your ex stopped you seeing your children after separation? A practical guide for dads on acting early, documenting evidence, domestic abuse, DARVO, child contact and protecting your relationship with your children.
items.imageAlt: Separated father seeking help after his ex stops contact with his children following a relationship breakdown

items.title: Not Everything Is Narcissism: Understanding the Overlap Between Cluster B Personality Disorders
items.author: Reiki Fish
items.excerpt: Not everything is narcissism. Explore the complex overlap between NPD, BPD, ASPD and HPD, why similar behaviours can have very different psychological origins, and how modern personality science is moving beyond simple diagnostic boxes.
items.imageAlt: Four overlapping human profiles representing the shared and distinct traits found across Cluster B personality disorders.

items.title: My Ex Is Using My Child Against Me: What Can I Actually Do?
items.author: Reiki Fish
items.excerpt: When a relationship with your child suddenly changes after separation, it can be devastating. This in-depth guide explores alienating behaviours, false or disputed allegations, children’s wishes, evidence and the family courts in Scotland and England.
items.imageAlt: Distressed parent coping with separation, child contact problems and alienating behaviours after a relationship breakdown.

items.title: Is It Really Narcissism? The Traits, Warning Signs and Red Flags People Get Wrong
items.author: Reiki Fish
items.excerpt: What are the real signs of narcissism? This evidence-led guide explores grandiosity, entitlement, empathy, vulnerability and relationship warning signs while separating genuine narcissistic traits from internet myths.
items.imageAlt: Woman facing an idealised mirror reflection, representing narcissistic grandiosity, vulnerability, self-image and personality traits.

items.title: The Book of DARVO: When Blame Becomes a Weapon
items.author: Reiki Fish
items.excerpt: The Book of DARVO is a new work from Andy Fish exploring what happens when accountability becomes blame reversal. Discover the psychology of DARVO, smear campaigns, coercive control, economic abuse, children caught in adult conflict and why evidence can be more powerful than retaliation.
items.imageAlt: The Book of DARVO by Andy Fish explores blame reversal, smear campaigns, coercive control and psychological abuse.

items.title: DARVO: When the Person Who Hurt You Claims to Be the Victim
items.author: Reiki Fish
items.excerpt: DARVO can turn accountability upside down. The person confronted about harmful behaviour denies what happened, attacks the credibility of the person raising it, then presents themselves as the real victim. This evidence-led guide examines the psychology of DARVO, coercive control, smear campaigns, post-separation abuse, children being drawn into adult conflict and the particular difficulties these patterns can create in family court.
items.imageAlt: Two adults in conflict with a reversing loop, representing denial, blame shifting and role reversal in DARVO.

items.title: How Can The Grey Principles Help Me Build a Positive Mindset When I Am Going Through Absolute Hell?
items.author: Reiki Fish
items.excerpt: A positive mindset does not mean pretending everything is fine. Discover how The Grey Method can help you face reality, find emotional balance, and move forwards when life feels unbearable.
items.imageAlt: The Grey Method Coaching helps people find emotional balance and a positive mindset during difficult times
